CALL FOR PROTEST

A group of Gen Z activists has announced a protest against corruption and political privilege on September 8 in front of the Parliament House, New Baneshwor, Kathmandu. This comes after a TikTok trend showing the huge gap between the luxurious lifestyles of politicians' children and the struggles of ordinary people.

The trend, which began in the Philippines and Indonesia, has gained popularity in Nepal, with videos showing politicians' families enjoying designer goods, private trips, and other luxury items, drawing widespread attention.
